tasks.name: Crest Bomber
tasks.description: A broad flying bomber that drops bombs after a clear warning.
tasks.design: NEW ENEMY: CREST BOMBER. A heavy but compact flying bomber with a broad arched shoulder wing like a shallow inverted gull wing, a rounded armored central fuselage, and TWO short chunky engine gondolas incorporated into the outer shoulders. Its silhouette should be wide and low, clearly different from the diamond Twin Darts and a long thin sniper craft. Bone-cream wing leading edges and rounded belly armor, olive wing tops, charcoal rear vents, small amber sensor on the LEFT-facing nose. Show the hinged bomb-bay doors OPEN beneath the central belly, revealing two restrained dull-copper cylindrical bomb canisters held safely in racks; nothing falling or firing yet. Heavy mechanical bomb-release latches, exposed hinge pins, ribbed engine housings, frost on wing roots and worn maintenance panels. No propellers, no real-world plane, no dangling legs or skis. It is visibly flying with ample open space between its belly and the snow; a soft shadow below establishes height. Glacier cliffs and fjord lie behind it. Keep both gondolas and open bomb bay recognizable.

tasks.name: Snow Roller
tasks.description: A grounded roller that launches shootable rolling charges.
tasks.design: NEW ENEMY: SNOW ROLLER. A squat compact armored snow-compaction machine converted by the invaders into a mobile charge launcher. It has ONE massive broad ribbed steel roller drum spanning its front at LEFT, and ONE smaller broad rear drum at RIGHT, connected by a low olive and cream central chassis. Both drums visibly CONTACT THE SNOW and leave compressed ribbed snow tracks; NOT skis, not tank tracks, not a hovering vehicle, not a walker. The near face of the front drum shows a large dark circular hub with radial bolts, the far edge reveals its broad cylindrical width. The chassis has a short slightly raised launcher tube above and behind the front drum, pointing LEFT and a little upward, a round feed magazine containing two dull metal spherical charges, a tiny amber warning lamp and exposed hydraulic brackets. The weapon muzzle must sit above the drum so a player flying low could shoot back. Frost and ice chips on the drum ribs, scratched pale panels, heavy rubber seals, slatted cooling vents. Keep the silhouette short and ROUND at the front, totally different from the existing long wedge skiff or boss. Exactly one small enemy machine in foreground on a continuous snowy coast, teal fjord beyond.

tasks.name: Needle Wing
tasks.description: A precision aircraft that locks its aim before firing one fast shot.
tasks.design: NEW ENEMY: NEEDLE WING. An unmanned precision-shooter aircraft with a long very SLENDER horizontal fuselage and a long forward railgun spine facing LEFT, contrasted with a SINGLE tall narrow swept dorsal stabilizer near the rear at RIGHT. A small downward ventral stabilizer balances the tall upper fin, and two short swept shoulder fins sit close to the central body; do NOT make a diamond or a broad-winged bomber. Its distinctive silhouette is a needle-shaped barrel and thin hull under a tall vertical rear fin. Olive upper armor, cream long nose shroud, charcoal gun rail recessed along the left-facing front, visible recoil sleeve, a small amber sighting sensor next to the barrel, narrow rear engine with dark ribbed nozzle. No laser beam or bullet; the warm small sighting lamp is the pre-shot warning. Delicate panel seams and fine frost on leading edges. The railgun looks engineered and compact rather than a giant boss cannon. Show one craft visibly airborne well above the snow, full barrel and all fins within frame. Distant layered ice cliffs and teal water provide a cool pale background so the slim machine reads clearly.

tasks.name: Wake Hunter
tasks.description: A curved-wing interceptor that warns before a fast diving pass.
tasks.design: NEW ENEMY: WAKE HUNTER. A fast airborne interceptor built for low sweeping passes along the glacier coast. It has a very SHORT angular central body with a sharp LEFT-facing nose and TWO broad curved swept-back crescent wings embracing the body, like a mechanically constructed manta silhouette but unmistakably a MACHINE. The wings curve backward toward the RIGHT, with a deep open notch between their trailing tips and the central engine. Unlike the flat diamond Twin Darts, its wings form clear curved hooks with articulated trailing-edge air brakes. Cream armored leading edges, olive wing panels, charcoal mechanical wing roots with exposed bearings and visible segmented air-brake plates, a compact amber nose sensor and two small forward gun ports beside it. A strong compact rear engine is visible between the hooked wings. Do not make a circular saw, ring, propeller, bird, organic creature, or familiar franchise fighter. Bank only slightly so the crescent outline and gun direction stay readable; this should still work as a side-scrolling sprite. Show it skimming above a snowy coastal shelf with ample clearance, a subtle swept snow wisp BELOW it, and teal water and fractured ice cliffs behind. No exhaust glow, no bullets, no motion blur hiding the detailed shape.
